metaDescription: Jagdeep, born 29 March 1939 in Datia. Full biography, family, career and awards.
lead: Jagdeep was an Indian actor, born on 29 March 1939 in Datia.
He died on 8 July 2020 in Mumbai at the age of 81.
He has 42 credited works on public record and has been recognised with the IIFA Lifetime Achievement Award.
Below you will find a verified overview of Jagdeep: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.
